entry.title: New: Resolution 717 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO HAWAI‘I ENVIRONMENTAL RESTORATION

Approves a grant of $6,510 to Hawai‘i Environmental Restoration, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to develop a digital georeference database to protect, identify, and catalogue historically, culturally, or environmentally sensitive sites on the Wai‘ele, Puna, property (Tax Map Keys: 1-4-003:003 and 037), pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawaiʻi County Charter.
